prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- If you want convenience and low price: Costco (if you have a membership) or Discount Tire (nearby in Dublin) are top choices.
- If you want personalized service or performance/European wheels: use a reputable independent shop in Pleasanton/Livermore — look for ASE-certified techs and an alignment rack.
If you want, I can pull up specific nearby shops, hours, and current prices — do you want me to search for locations within Pleasanton only or within, say, 10 miles?

Why those recommendations
- Costco Tire Center — excellent prices on many tire brands, consistent mounting/installation quality, and good road-hazard coverage for members. Wait times can be long.
- Discount Tire (and America’s Tire/Discount Tire Direct) — strong customer service, usually competitive pricing, widely praised for mounting/balancing and warranty service.
- Independent shops (local tire centers, European-specialty shops, or a well-reviewed mom-and-pop shop) — often better for specialty tires, custom wheels, performance balancing/road-force balancing, and quicker, more flexible service.
- Chains like Firestone/Pep Boys/NTB are fine if they have a good local reputation and certified techs; they’re convenient and run frequent promotions.

How to pick the best installer (quick checklist)
- Reviews: check Google and Yelp for installation-specific comments (mounting, balancing, lug-torque, TPMS).
- Certifications/equipment: ASE-certified techs, alignment rack, road-force balancer (helpful for vibrations).
- What’s included: mounting, standard balancing, new valve stems, tire disposal, TPMS reset, lug-nut torque, lifetime rotations and balancing? Ask before buying.
- Warranties & road-hazard coverage: does the tire purchase include prorated replacements or road-hazard protection?
- Price and availability: compare total out-the-door price (tires + mounting + balancing + fees + alignment if needed).
- Turnaround time and appointment availability.

Questions to help me narrow it down
- Do you want the cheapest option, best install quality, or best all-around value?
- Do you have a membership (Costco)?
- Vehicle type (car/SUV/light truck/high-performance)? Any wheel size/special tires?
- How far from Pleasanton are you willing to go (in-town only, within 10 miles, etc.)?

If you want, I’ll look up the top-rated Pleasanton-area shops and give addresses, phone numbers, and a quick comparison. Which radius should I search?
